question: The value of all final goods and services produced within a country is called the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**GDP**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**

 
 
• **​**Gross domestic product is the **sum of the final prices of goods and services produced in an economy over a specific time period.​**
 
• **All private and public consumption, government outlays, investments, increases in private inventory, paid building expenses, and the foreign balance of trade** are all included in the calculation of a country's GDP.
 
 
 
• **Types of Gross Domestic Product**
 
 
• **​Real GDP**
 
 
• **​The value of all goods and services produced by an economy in a given year**.
 
 
 
• **Nominal GDP**
 
 
• **​**Nominal GDP is** a measure of economic output in a country that takes into account current prices**.
 
 
 
• **GDP Per Capita**
 
 
• **​**GDP per capita is** a measure of GDP per capita in a country's population**.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Value-added tax (VAT)**

 
 
• **​**Value-added tax (VAT) is a consumption tax on goods and services that is levied at each stage of the supply chain where value is added, from initial production to the point of sale.
 
 
 
• **Infant mortality rate**
 
 
• **​**The infant mortality rate is the number of deaths per 1,000 live births for children under one year of age.
 
 
 
• **Goods and Services Tax**
 
 
• **​**Goods and Services Tax is an indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services.
